_how_to: Notices shown to EMerge users who opted in with: python -m emerge updates on
This file is read from the 'main' branch on GitHub once per day. Edits go live after pushing to main.
Each notice in the 'notices' list has these fields:
id        (required) Unique name, never reuse one. Users see each id only once.
message   (required) Plain text shown to the user. Keep it to one or two sentences.
affects   (optional) Versions that see it, e.g. '>=3.0.0a1,<3.0.0a21' or '==3.0.0'. Leave out for all versions.
severity  (optional) 'info', 'warning' (default) or 'critical'. Critical is repeated daily until the user upgrades.
url       (optional) Link to an issue or release notes.
enabled   (optional) Set to false to switch a notice off without deleting it. Default: true.
test      (optional) Set to true for test notices. They are never shown to users, only in dev/launch_messages_demo.py.
Before pushing, check your edits with: python -m emerge updates notices --file notices.json
